source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the steps and uses of PCR (PDF 160-162).

blocks.text: Sab se pehle DNA ke tukre (gene of interest) mein primer zyada miqdar mein milaya jata hai. Primer 20 se 30 nucleotides ka chhota silsila hota hai. Primers aur DNA ke is mixture ko taqreeban 98°C tak garam kiya jata hai. Is temperature par double-stranded DNA toot kar single strands (akele strands) mein alag ho jata hai. Har single-stranded DNA in vitro (test tube mein, jism se bahar) DNA banane ke liye template (saancha) ka kaam kar sakta hai.
Step 2: Annealing of Primer (primer ka jurna)

Ab mehlool (solution) ko taqreeban 60°C tak thanda hone diya jata hai. Thanda hote hue forward aur backward primers single-stranded DNA par apni complementary (jor wali) jagahon se jur jate hain (anneal ya hybridize hote hain). Baqi tukra single-stranded hi rehta hai.
Step 3: Extension of Primer (primer ko lamba karna)

Ab garmi bardasht karne wala DNA polymerase, jise Taq polymerase kehte hain, dala jata hai. Chaaron qisam ke nucleotides bhi dale jate hain. Taq polymerase primer ke 3’ sire par naye nucleotides jorta jata hai. Is tarah woh DNA replication ki tarah tukre ka baqi hissa copy kar leta hai, aur poore single-stranded DNA ki complementary copy primer ke saath ban jati hai. Kyun ke dono DNA strands copy hue, is liye ab asal DNA tukre ki do copies hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “complimentary copy” likhti hai. Sahi lafz complementary hai: aisi copy jis ke bases template strand ke bases se jora banate hain (A ke saamne T, G ke saamne C). “Complimentary” ka matlab muft ya tareefi hota hai.

Step 1 se 3 dobara kiye jate hain aur do copies chaar ban jati hain. Mazeed polymerase dalne ki zaroorat nahin, kyun ke garam karne se yeh enzyme kharab nahin hota. Har cycle aik ya do minute mein mukammal hoti hai aur DNA molecules ki tadaad dugni kar deti hai. 20 cycles ke baad DNA ka aik tukra das laakh (one million) se zyada copies bana deta hai.

blocks.alt: Upar se neeche silsila. Gene of interest wala do-strand DNA aur azad primers (P). Heat: 1- Denaturation strands alag karta hai. Cool: 2- Annealing, har strand se aik primer P jurta hai. DNA polymerase (Taq polymerase) aur azad nucleotides: 3- Extension naye strands banata hai, 2 copies (Cycle 1). Phir garam aur thanda: 4 copies (Cycle 2), phir 8 copies (Cycle 3). Purane strands neele, naye surkh; dono asal strands sirf do copies mein rehte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.6: PCR ke qadam (kitab ki Figure 20.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Gene of interest, Primers, Heat, Cool, Denaturation, Annealing, Extension, 2/4/8 copies, Cycle 1-3.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har cycle mein DNA dugna hota hai: 1 se 2, 2 se 4, 4 se 8 copies. Neele strands asal (purane) hain aur surkh naye. Har cycle ke teen hisse hain: Heat (taqreeban 98°C, strands alag), Cool (taqreeban 60°C, primers jurte hain) aur Taq polymerase se extension (72°C).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 20.6 Cycle 3 ki 8 copies mein teen jagah asal (neela) strand dikhati hai. Asal DNA ke sirf do strands hain, is liye 8 copies mein se sirf do mein asal strand ho sakta hai. Upar ke khaake mein yeh sahi dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: For information (maloomat)
blocks.text: PCR genomic library banane mein bhi kaam aati hai. Genomic library kisi aik jandar ke kul DNA ka majmua (collection) hai. Genomic libraries aam taur par DNA ki sequencing (nucleotides ki tarteeb maloom karne) ke liye istemal hoti hain.

blocks.title: For information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Taq polymerase garmi bardasht karne wala enzyme hai jo Thermus aquaticus se hasil kiya gaya; yeh bacterium garam chashmon (hot springs) mein milta hai. Yeh enzyme ubalne ke qareeb temperature par bhi theek rehta aur kaam karta rehta hai.

blocks.title: For information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Primer ki extension ke liye behtareen (optimum) temperature 72°C hai. Yeh step sirf aik minute mein mukammal ho jata hai.

items: Yeh bimari phelane wale jaraseem (infectious agents) ke genotypes pehchanne ki behtareen diagnostic (tashkhees ki) technique hai.
Is se woh genetic mutations pakri jati hain jo kuch genetic bimariyon aur cancers ka sabab hain.
Jurm ki tafteesh mein sookhe khoon ke bohat chhote namoone ya insaan ke aik baal ki jar ke cells se “DNA fingerprints” banaye jate hain.
Doctor bohat shuru ke embryos (janeen) ke chand jhare hue (sloughed-off) cells le kar un ka DNA barha kar genetic nuqs (defects) maloom kar sakte hain.
PCR se extinct (khatam ho chuki) species ka DNA bhi jancha jata hai, bas shart yeh hai ke un ke DNA ki bohat thori si miqdar bhi saalim bachi ho.

blocks.prompt: Aik DNA molecule se shuru kar ke 5 PCR cycles ke baad kitni copies hongi?
blocks.explanation: Har cycle copies dugni karti hai: 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 2⁵ = 32 copies. Isi tarah 20 cycles ke baad 2²⁰ = 1,048,576, yaani das laakh se zyada copies.

items: Denaturation (taqreeban 98°C): DNA single strands mein alag.
Annealing (taqreeban 60°C): forward aur backward primers complementary jagahon se jurte hain.
Extension (optimum 72°C): Taq polymerase (Thermus aquaticus se) primer ke 3’ sire par nucleotides jorta hai.
Har cycle 1-2 minute, DNA dugna; 20 cycles mein das laakh se zyada copies.
Istemal: infections ki tashkhees, mutations, DNA fingerprints, embryos ki jaanch, extinct species ka DNA, genomic library.
